prompt:
Create a production-ready GAME VFX ALPHA MASK SPRITE SHEET, not a colored illustration. Exactly 16 sequential animation frames in a strict 4-column by 4-row grid of equal cells. Transparent background; no visible grid, border, labels, typography, checkerboard, sword object, or background scenery. White/grayscale alpha only. Intended for a 2D Terraria-style flying sword's ONE unified energy sheath: trailing wake, blade-body flow, lively edges and leading airbreak must all belong to the SAME connected flowing silhouette, not separate effects.

Each cell is a wide horizontal stream pointing RIGHT, identical registration in all 16 cells. In normalized coordinates of EVERY cell: centerline y=50%; physical sword pivot x=67%; narrow leading point x=91%, fixed; broad blade-body region x=43% to 89%; trailing wake tapers from x=43% toward x=6%. Keep overall shape within x=5..93%, y=27..73%, leaving generous gutters. There is no painted metal sword, no hilt, no handle, no crossguard: this is ONLY an alpha silhouette that will be laid over the real sword.

Art direction: polished hand-painted action-game VFX, clean readable continuous filled blade-like core, graceful tapered flowing wake, fine organic streaming edge tongues that travel from the right nose towards the left tail. Low-noise soft feathering at the very outer edge, crisp controlled leading point. Subtle translucent gray edge wisps, strongest white opacity along the connected central body, no large empty holes in the body. Draw an integrated streamlined sheath, not a solid rectangular sticker. Outer contours actively evolve and curl in each consecutive frame, showing energy turning over and sweeping backward; the central blade stays anchored and the tip stays in the exact same place. Frame 16 transitions smoothly to frame 1. The motion is in the silhouette itself, not translation, rotation or a globally pulsing scale.

Absolutely avoid: V-shaped chevrons, triangular side rails, crescent caps, rings, orbiting circles, cross-shaped stars, separate spark particles, multiple parallel disconnected ribbons, jagged antlers, dirty smoke, burnt-paper holes, broken blobs, thick outlines, lens flare, rainbow colors. Do not repeat one identical static shape 16 times. Every frame needs a clear, smooth, logically advancing ripple phase while retaining the same body and tip registration. Use true transparent alpha, with white mask pixels and naturally feathered opacity. Keep all cells uniform and cleanly separable.
notes: Source copied unchanged; active.png uses alpha extraction and integer frame registration. Not final-approved.
